name: Sea Spray Resort & Marina
brand_truth: An Albury boat-building name at the head of White Sound, rebuilt after Dorian by four friends who boat: 62 slips to 130 ft, 7 ft of draft.
buyer: US East Coast sportfish owners and captains planning Abaco runs on a phone; villa guests; residence buyers.

direction.lane: P02 Shallow flats (salt ground, ink field, channel accent)
direction.motion: Ken Burns hero, scroll-scrubbed chapter crossfades
direction.why: Their own photography is film-grade; a captain's question (fit and cost) answered on the second screen, then a day at Sea Spray as a film.

concept_type: booking-site (marina-first: slip check and request, Guesty stays, Revel ordering)
big_idea: White Sound at rest, then 'Will she fit, and what will it cost?': a length rule and published rates give yes/no and an estimate, carried into a WhatsApp slip request; then a day at Sea Spray as a pinned film of their own photographs.
current_site_findings: Header phone link dials a US number (606-706-9411) instead of +1 242 577 4696
Homepage leads with 'Own a Piece of Paradise' before telling a boater where the marina is or whether they fit
Event cards read 'Button Button' and the four events repeat three times
Specs and rates only on an inner page
WhatsApp link has no country code
pitch_line: A captain can tell from the cockpit whether his boat fits White Sound and what three nights will cost, and send the slip request in one tap.
assumptions: Low season 90+ day rate not published: calculator uses the 30+ rate and says to ask
Beach photo location not captioned (not confirmed as Elbow Cay)
WhatsApp on +1 242 577 4696 (own site links WhatsApp to this number)
